summary.overview: Dashboard broken since last deploy. Search needs date/status filters. Mobile app requested for field team.

sentences.text: Hey Sam, thanks for the time. I want to get right into some issues we've been dealing with.
The dashboard is completely broken for us right now — the charts don't load at all since your last deploy on Friday. Our ops team is flying blind.
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. I'll escalate that immediately after this call.

Please do, it's pretty urgent. Also separately — the search filter could be a lot better. Right now it only searches by name but we need to filter by date range and status too. It would save our team a lot of time.
Makes sense, we've heard that from a few customers. I'll add it to the backlog.
And one more thing — this is more of a longer-term ask — but we'd love a mobile app at some point. Our field team can't use the web app effectively on their phones. They're out on-site all day.
A mobile app is definitely something we've been thinking about. I'll note that as a feature request.
That would be great. Overall the platform has been valuable, we just want these rough edges smoothed out.
